$comment: Single source of truth for the ops contract (plan P0-06; design T2 S1).
tools/gen-schema.mjs generates engine/src/ops/ops.def (X-macro), engine/src/ops/schema.gen.{h,cc},
runtime/src/shared/ops.gen.mjs and docs/schema-table.md. Ids and since values are immutable and
mirrored in schema.lock.json. A change of meaning or encoding of an existing row needs a
MIN_COMPAT bump; new vocabulary takes the next since (plan MD-03).
Domains: bool | int:LO:HI | num:LO:HI | str | token (may be empty) | ident | label | lang |
enum:A|B|C | flags:NAME=BIT,... | rangeset | color | font | html | url | delta (a node: a childless
styled node, the style change it carries — plan P2-08). retired: the version an attribute left the
vocabulary (its row stays in the lock; plan P2-08: styled.bits).
Attribute order is the writer's order (today's constructor argument order).
Text (plan P2-10): U+000A in the text of an inline-model body is a soft break (a line join),
resolved at instantiation — a space, or nothing between two wide characters (TextRules joinsWide);
code and verbatim bodies (body code / text) keep their newlines.
Universal attributes (plan P2-05; design T2 S9): every kind but doc and text accepts them, after
its own attributes; a kind that already has one keeps its own row (heading/group/table/term/
mathblock label and group role, since 6). label: an anchor; role: the element class's name; slot:
the part of its parent it fills (caption, margin, …); syn: the kind of generated text it is (absent
= content); copy: text | omit | replace:<text> (how a copy reads it); class: style tokens (T4);
ext: EXT name/value pairs (scalar user data, opaque to emit and layout). Flags: resolved = only the
resolver sets it (dropped from input). (plan P2-08, since 11) style: the node's own style change, a
delta node (a childless styled node); attach: prev | next | both — no line break between the node's
inline extent and what precedes / follows it (a footnote marker attaches to its word).
Slots (plan P2-16; design T2 SlotSpec, INTEGRATION: the universal `slot`): the values of the slot
attribute a kind gives a meaning — a child in a slot is a part of its parent, not its content: it is
exempt from the parent's body model and its own children sit at the slot's model. on: the kinds
that take it, or "block" for every block-level kind. Consumers read the generated id (SlotId).

margin.doc: a code block's sidecar lines: one seq per logical line (P2-13)

extra.doc: a reference's bracket: its supplement word or a citation's locator (P2-09)

tag.doc: a block's tag in the margin: an equation's number, a site's mark (P3-03, T6)

caption.doc: a figure's caption paragraphs (P3-03): its caption site attaches there, the semantic page's figcaption holds them

$comment: Declaration types (plan P2-05; design T2 S9; D-I06, D-I07): a DECL op carries one, with a name, EXT
data and templates, at its flow position. binding hoisted: the document's last declaration of a name
wins wherever it is (decl-redeclared info); positional: each applies from its position on. owner: the
plan step whose consumer reads it. Declarations are never region-scoped.
The constructor ABI (plan P2-03; docs/ctor-design.md). A kind's "ctor" is its public constructor:
name (default: the kind), params bound left to right (attr:NAME[:DOMAIN] | projected:NAME | text |
lines | body), nullary (a bare #name calls it), sealed (no override); every attribute not bound
positionally is an option. Here: the derived constructors (kind: the node they make; options "raw":
the options object reaches the implementation unvalidated), the std functions and the option aliases.
The names reach the hole module and the manifest from these tables; the implementations live in
runtime/src/shared/stdlib.mjs.
Textual value domains (plan P1-02): a byte-level regular expression (whole-string match) and a
maximum UTF-8 length (0 = none). tools/gen-schema.mjs compiles each to a DFA for C++ (the ops
reader's authoritative check) and to a RegExp for JS; \x80-\xff means any non-ASCII character.

names.$comment: Space-separated names, or none (plan P3-22: codeblock.overlays; empty switches a profile's off).

tracks.$comment: A table's columns (plan P3-14; design T6 TableSpec): width[:align] by commas — width auto | min | max (content-fitted), Nfr (a share of the room left), Nem / Npx (fixed), N% (of the measure); align l | c | r.

lens.$comment: One to four lengths, CSS shorthand order (top, right, bottom, left): a box's padding or border widths (plan P3-14).

$comment: Run properties (plans P1-02, P2-08; design T4 M2/M5): one row per Styling field, in field order.
type: weight (u16; 0 = inherited, read as 400) | bool | flags (u8; `flags`: name → bit, ORed) | enum (u8; 0 = none,
`values` from 1) | mul (size multiplier, composed by the engine) | str (an interned string) | px (absolute px) |
internal (engine-set, never on the wire: the script T5's classifier gives a run, which selects its face).
attr: the styled/STYLE_PUSH attribute that patches it (domain: that attribute's); sugar: $.style.push keys and the
value each sets; key: its $.style.push key when not the attribute's name (code.hang: {code: {hang}}); dump: the label in the tree/block
dumps; html: an attribute the typeset serializer writes; css + cssOrder: the declaration it writes (cssFlags: flag →
keyword; cssValue emPx: the run's em in px).

text.weight.$comment: 700 is the contract class tsr-b; another weight but 400 is written as font-weight (plan P3-23: the page paints the weight it measured).

par.singleLine.$comment: A paragraph that is one line is set as par.align says (align) or centred (center: D-Y05, a caption's LaTeX singlelinecheck), plan P3-09.

codeblock.overlays.$comment: The overlays a code block's body gets (plan P3-22; design T9 A6): names of engine/schema/languages.json overlays, space-separated — spans the engine finds and sets as one token whatever the provider says (noweb: <<fragment>> names). A fence profile (cpp-literate) sets them by a default rule.

keep.$comment: The block trait group (plan P3-14; design T6 S12): keep, space, break, par.hang, box, media, beside, breaker, place — together with par.align/hyphenate and block.gap. keep: a page cut inside the block (together) or after it (with-next) is avoided, relaxed in D-Y04's order.

par.hang.$comment: A hanging indent: the lines after the first par.hangAfter (default 1) start this far in.

media.$comment: Where the block shows: everywhere, on screen only, on paged sheets only (a layout-time filter).

beside.$comment: A non-paragraph block beside a float: clears it (D-Y02, the default) or narrows to the room left.

place.float.$comment: Where a block goes (plans P3-14, P3-15; design T6 Place): in the flow (none); floated to the start / end side, text beside it (left, right); a page float — on paged sheets at the top or bottom of its sheet, or on a sheet of floats (top, bottom, page), in place on screen; an inline block, side by side with its inline siblings (inline: subfigures). An image's side is its alias.

place.width.$comment: A placed block's width: a length or a percent of its container; unset, its content's (FitBody: the widest of its non-caption content, at most the room).

place.gap.$comment: The room between a placed block and what stands beside it (text beside a float, the next inline block); unset: an em.

text.space.$comment: How a run's white space is painted (plan P3-18, design T4 M8): as the line breaker set it (normal) or as written (pre: code) — the class tsr-pre.

text.classes.$comment: The style classes in force on a run (plan P3-18, design T4 M8): its nodes' `class` tokens and a code token's tok-<tag>, sorted, metric-neutral — written tsr-c-<name>; engine-set (no attribute).

$comment: Host settings (plan P1-03; design T4 M3 / T9 A4): one row per setting, by dotted path.
field: the Config member (cost.* fill CostParams); dom: value domain (a domains entry, num:LO:HI, int:LO:HI, bool,
enum:A|B, str, map, json); def: default; prec: HostOnly | HostDefault | HostForce | DocOnly (no document layer before P3);
affects: the stages (stages.def) whose products the setting changes — the first one decides whether a patch
applies in place or the document is rebuilt; legacy: the createEngine/tsr_* option it replaces (MD-06).
terms.* override single locale words (semantic/terms.h, plan P1-10); unset, the document language's locale pack decides.
semantics.* (plan P2-07; dom json: an object, kept as its JSON text) patch the element registry's rows by name,
field by field, in engine/data/elements.json's form: built-in rows < these < the document's declarations.
optional: an empty string is accepted (the row is unset and resolution falls through).

doc.lang.$comment: The document's language (plan P3-30, D-T06): a BCP-47 tag, or auto — detected from its text at ingest (docinfo reports it); the document's own $.doc({lang}) wins over the host's.

fonts.cjk.def: "Noto Serif CJK SC", "Source Han Serif SC", "Songti SC", SimSun, serif

math.breakAfter.$comment: Where an inline formula may break (plan P3-25; design T8 Lazy MathLayout): the penalty after an atom of each class (a missing class: no break there); a break between two atoms costs min(after its left, before its right).

math.breakBefore.$comment: The penalty before an atom of each class (plan P3-25): a relation may head the continuation line (the CJK convention), TeX breaks after it.

code.minCols.$comment: The fewest columns a code block's grid keeps (verbatim-design §2; plan P3-02: it was a literal 8).

code.snapTolerance.$comment: Snap-kerning applies when the letter-spacing it needs is at most this fraction of a character (verbatim-design §3; plan P3-02).

code.snapMaxQ.$comment: The largest denominator of the CJK:Latin grid ratio (verbatim-design §2: beyond it a grid stops reading as monospace; plan P3-02).

layout.minWrapWidth.$comment: The narrowest column text wraps in beside floats, in em of doc.baseSize (plan P3-08; design T6 ParShape): a paragraph whose line would be narrower clears the floats instead.

table.cellPad.$comment: A table cell's horizontal padding, in em of doc.baseSize (plan P3-02).

table.rowPad.$comment: A table row's vertical padding, in em of doc.baseSize (plan P3-02).

page.width.$comment: The page's content width in px (plan P3-12; design T6 PageSpec): the measure print lays the document out at. With page.height and page.margin it is the sheet: content plus margins (the defaults: A4 at 96 dpi with 64px margins).

page.margin.$comment: The page's margin in px on every side (plan P3-12; design T6 PageSpec).

semantics.html.$comment: The host's presentation rows (plan P3-23; design T7 PresentationMap): elements.json html rows by name, patched field by field.

render.idPrefix.$comment: The prefix of every element id and internal href the serializers spell (plan P3-06; design T7 AnchorNamer): a page that holds two documents, or a print root beside the live view, gives each its own.

render.math.$comment: How the plain page (first paint, static export, a fragment) shows a formula (plan P3-27; design T7 S13, D-R07): boxes — the typeset page's glyph boxes, its text runs estimated before measurement — or source ($…$, a feed's choice).

a11y.mathLabel.$comment: A formula's box is role=math with its source as aria-label, on both pages (plan P3-27, D-R04).

a11y.textLayer.$comment: The typeset lines are hidden from assistive technology and the shell keeps a visually hidden copy of each block's content text beside them (plan P3-27; design T7 S13): screen readers read words, not lines and hyphens. Off by default.

style.rules.$comment: The host's rules (plan P3-01; design T4 Rules, D-T03, D-T08): env 1, after the engine's defaults — an array of [selector, patch] or {select, patch, force}; a forced rule applies over a node's own style.

$comment: The render contract's metric-bearing classes (plan P3-18; design T4 M8): each class a run
carries when its style says so, and the CSS it stands for — both generated from here, so the
classes the serializer writes and the stylesheet the shell injects never drift (a theme must
not override them: the dev audit checks). Class order is the serializer's. `rules`: further
contract rules on combinations; `squeeze`: the CJK punctuation half the engine squeezes, read
from the TextRules data (T5) until P4-04 writes explicit px.

tsr-pre.$comment: word-spacing: 0 (plan P3-30): its spaces are rigid in the engine; a justified line's word-spacing must not reach them

rules: /* (plan P3-19, T7 S11) a line's box is its runs' content areas: a run's line-height is its face's content height (the container's factors); a code row's strut is the code face, centred in its row */
.tsr-cjk.tsr-i { font-style: normal; text-emphasis: filled dot; text-emphasis-position: under right; }
.tsr-doc a.tsr-sup { position: relative; top: -0.45em; text-decoration: none; }

$comment: Host policy (plan P1-03; design T9 A4): how hosts drive the engine, not what it typesets.
Not a document setting: createEngine({policy}) and the native driver read it.

maxRounds.doc: pull-loop rounds before a typeset is declared stalled

fontDeadlineMs.doc: declared fonts measure as their fallback after this

fontRetryMs.doc: a failed font load is retried after this

grammarRetryMs.doc: a failed highlight grammar load is retried after this

sessionBudgetBytes.doc: the worker Session's answer cache and memo budget (content-keyed: widths, vertical metrics, code tokens, KP results)

resourceCacheEntries.doc: the resource host's LRU cache of URL-keyed answers (image sizes, loads): entries kept

resourceCacheBytes.doc: the resource host's LRU cache: bytes of loaded resources kept

resourceTtlMs.doc: a cached resource is revalidated (ETag, Last-Modified; a file's mtime and size) after this

resourceFailureTtlMs.doc: a failed resource (an image that did not load, a missing file) is retried after this
